**Pencil is the right tool to use.** Your team file (`docs/conventions/user-interface.yaml`) marks Pencil as confirmed and puts Figma on hold. **Installing Pencil is a manual desktop install, not a single command.** Its install page (https://docs.pen.dev/getting-started/installation) says to do this on Linux/WSL:

1. Download the AppImage or tarball for your machine from the pen.dev downloads page.
2. Run it, for example `chmod +x Pen-linux-x86_64.AppImage && ./Pen-linux-x86_64.AppImage`.
3. Open any `.pen` file, then turn on the Claude Code integration in Pencil's MCP settings.
4. Restart Claude Code and run `/mcp` to check that `pencil` shows as connected.

The page also says to install Claude Code with `npm install -g`. You don't need that because you already have it, so I left it out. It doesn't mention signing in, but it links to a separate Authentication page that may require an account.

**What the design will be based on:** you have no token file or component library. The look lives in inline styles in `src/settings/SettingsScreen.jsx`:
- **Layout:** content column up to 640px wide with 24px padding, using the Inter font.
- **Headings:** the page title is 24px and section titles are 16px.
- **Sections:** Profile, Notifications and Danger zone, separated by a `#E5E7EB` divider line.
- **Danger zone:** red `#B91C1C` for the heading and the button, which has 6px rounded corners.

I'll copy that look exactly and won't redesign it. The `.pen` file will have one frame per section, and those values will be set up as reusable colors and text styles your designer can edit.
